### Jesus Sees a Woman’s Tears
Author: Sharon Jaynes
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-july-3-2024.html
Passage: Luke 7:13
Points:
- The widow in Nain faced total heartbreak and destitution after losing her only son.
- In God's sovereign timing, Jesus crossed paths with the funeral procession at the gate.
- Moved with profound compassion, Jesus intervened without the mother asking or showing faith.
- Christ tenderly addressed her sorrow, telling her not to weep before restoring her child.
- Believers can take comfort knowing Jesus notices our grief and cares for our broken hearts.

### Our Compassionate Shepherd
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-september-29-2024.html
Passage: Luke 7:13-14
Points:
- Jesus reveals the nature of God's kingdom through acts of deep mercy rather than worldly displays.
- The bereft widow was left without protection, provision, or earthly hope.
- Seeing her grief stirred Jesus to His core, demonstrating that He truly feels our pain.
- By commanding the young man to arise, Jesus exercised His divine authority over death.
- The Lord unites infinite power with infinite compassion to bring His people through every sorrow.
